Name: Kari's Delivery Service - Retextured Seasonal Variants - Mailbox Mod
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/kariiiii/mods?mediaType=video&gameId=1303]Kari's[/url]﻿ original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24758]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24758[/url]﻿
Thank you Kari for an amazing mailbox retexture mod and for allowing me to edit/upload it! ♡

[u][b]Please Note:[/b][/u]
This mod requires Alternative Textures (AT) and SMAPI for it to work, and I highly recommend downloading the Content Patcher (CP) version of Kari's mod for a more immersive experience!

For Kari's mod -
CP version for the default textures [b]automatically[/b] changes with season/green rain weather. AT versions only [b]manually[/b] changes the mailbox texture. Download both versions for multiplayer functionality.
